description: Masked three-scale LocalHistogramEqualization on a view, in one call, with an optional HDRMultiscaleTransform pass. The mask is the image lightness (CIE L* for colour, the image itself for mono) mapped as max((L - mask_clip_low) / (1 - mask_clip_low), 0), raised to the power 1/mask_gamma and blurred with a Gaussian of sigma mask_blur (0 = no blur). LHE then runs at the large, mid and fine radius in that order through the mask; the large and mid scales use lhe_slope_limit, the fine scale lhe_fine_slope_limit; other LHE parameters are PixInsight's defaults. Giving hdrmt_layers adds an HDRMultiscaleTransform pass through the same mask. The mask is closed afterwards. Reports a detail score before and after: the mean squared Sobel gradient of luminance (Rec.709 weights) over pixels brighter than median + 8 x 1.4826 x MAD, sampled every 8 pixels.

hdrmt_inverted.description: HDRMT inverted iterations (needs hdrmt_layers; omitted = PixInsight default)

hdrmt_iterations.description: HDRMT number of iterations (needs hdrmt_layers; omitted = PixInsight default)

hdrmt_layers.description: HDRMultiscaleTransform number of layers. Giving it runs the HDRMT pass; omitted, no HDRMT runs

hdrmt_median_transform.description: HDRMT median transform instead of the wavelet transform (needs hdrmt_layers; omitted = PixInsight default)

hdrmt_to_lightness.description: HDRMT toLightness: on a colour image, apply the transform to the lightness only (needs hdrmt_layers; omitted = PixInsight default)

lhe_fine_radius.description: Fine-scale LHE kernel radius in pixels

lhe_fine_slope_limit.description: LHE contrast slope limit of the fine scale

lhe_large_radius.description: Large-scale LHE kernel radius in pixels

lhe_mid_radius.description: Mid-scale LHE kernel radius in pixels

lhe_slope_limit.description: LHE contrast slope limit of the large and mid scales

mask_blur.description: Gaussian blur sigma of the mask in pixels (0 = no blur)

mask_clip_low.description: Lightness mapped to 0 in the mask; values above it are rescaled to 0-1

mask_gamma.description: Mask gamma: the rescaled mask is raised to the power 1/mask_gamma (1 = unchanged)

view_id.description: View ID to enhance (modified in place)

name: multi_scale_enhance
